name: Gigneo – Multipurpose Freelance Service Marketplace
author: deveasel

sections.description:
Gigneo is a complete WordPress freelance marketplace plugin that turns any WordPress and WooCommerce site into a fully functioning gig marketplace, job marketplace, or service marketplace platform. Built for agencies, startups, and entrepreneurs who want to launch any service marketplace without touching a single line of code, Gigneo gives you the tools to connect freelancers and clients in one seamless ecosystem.

Instead of stitching together plugins, page builders, and custom code to build a marketplace, Gigneo bundles everything you need into one plugin: freelancer profiles, gig listings, job postings, proposals, secure messaging, wallet and escrow payments, reviews, and a full membership system.

Visit Site | Read Docs

Why Choose Gigneo

  • Works with any theme: Gigneo works with the theme you already have, including any design.

  • Built for both models: Run a gig marketplace (sellers list services) or a job marketplace (buyers post projects and freelancers bid), or run both at once.

  • WooCommerce native: Payments, checkout, and order management run on WooCommerce, so you inherit an ecosystem of extensions, payment gateways, and tax tools that already work.

  • No-code setup: Every core workflow, from commission rules to credit plans, is configurable from the WordPress admin dashboard.

  • Built to scale: From a niche freelancer directory to a large multi-vendor service economy, Gigneo’s architecture is designed to grow with your traffic and transaction volume.

Gigneo removes the two biggest barriers to launching a freelance marketplace platform: development cost and technical complexity. You get a production-ready marketplace engine, WooCommerce powered payments, and a clean dashboard experience for both freelancers and clients, all inside the WordPress admin you already know.

Note: Gigneo is designed as a marketplace engine. It works with your existing WordPress theme and Elementor setup rather than requiring a proprietary theme, giving you full creative control over design.

Gigneo Features

Gigneo ships with everything a modern service marketplace or job marketplace needs, right out of the box.

Marketplace Core:

  • Freelancer Dashboard: A dedicated frontend dashboard where freelancers manage services, proposals, orders, earnings, messages, and profile settings without ever visiting wp-admin.

  • Client Dashboard: A matching dashboard for employers and buyers to post jobs, review proposals, message freelancers, track orders, and manage payments.

  • Service Marketplace: Freelancers create structured service listings with packages, pricing tiers, add-ons, gallery images, and delivery timeframes.

  • Job Marketplace: Employers post jobs with budgets, deadlines, and required skills, and freelancers apply directly.

  • Service Listings: Flexible service catalog structure that supports fixed-price offers, hourly rates, and custom packages.

  • Proposals & Bidding: Freelancers submit tailored proposals with custom pricing and delivery timelines for posted jobs.

  • Developer Friendly: Gigneo is built with developers in mind. With a modular architecture, extensive hooks and filters, and comprehensive documentation, you can easily customize and extend the plugin to fit your specific marketplace needs.

Payments & Monetization:

  • Wallet System: Every user gets an internal wallet to track balances, withdrawals, and transaction history.

  • Escrow & Secure Payments: Funds are held securely until project or deliverables are approved, protecting both sides of the transaction.

  • Commission Management: Configure global or per-category commission rates, giving you full control over marketplace revenue.

  • Earnings & Payouts: Automated earnings tracking with configurable payout schedules and withdrawal methods.

Platform & Design:

  • Elementor Compatibility: Build custom marketplace pages, landing pages, and profile layouts visually with Elementor.

  • WooCommerce Integration: Leverages WooCommerce for checkout, order management, and compatibility with popular payment gateways.

  • Responsive Design: Fully responsive frontend that works cleanly across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

  • SEO Friendly: Clean URL structures, schema-ready templates, and optimized markup to help marketplace pages rank.

  • Performance Optimized: Lightweight queries and conditional asset loading keep your marketplace fast even as listings grow.

  • Security First: Nonce verification, capability checks, and sanitized inputs across every frontend form and AJAX request.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or greater
  • PHP version 8.0 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.0 or greater
  • WooCommerce 8.0 or greater

Recommended Requirements

  • PHP version 8.3 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.6 or greater
  • WordPress Memory limit of 64 MB or greater (128 MB or higher is preferred)
  • WooCommerce 8.0 or greater

Installation

  1. Install using the WordPress built-in Plugin installer, or Extract the zip file and drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to: WP Admin → Gigneo
  4. Now you can use the gigneo features like freelance marketplace, service marketplace, job marketplace, wallet payments, order management, withdrawals, proposals, and commissions.

For documentation and tutorials visit our Knowledge Base.
sections.faq:
What is Gigneo plugin?

Gigneo is an all-in-one freelancer marketplace plugin for WordPress designed to help you launch professional service marketplaces, freelance platforms, and job marketplaces without custom development.

How do I install Gigneo?

To install the Gigneo, follow the steps below:
From your WordPress dashboard -> Go to Plugins -> Click on ‘Add new’-> In the Search field, enter Gigneo and choose Gigneo.
Press install -> After installation, click Activate.

Can I use Gigneo to create a freelance marketplace?

Yes, Gigneo is perfect for building a freelance marketplace where freelancers can create profiles, list their services, and connect with clients. It’s ideal for digital services, creative gigs, and remote work.

Can I use Gigneo to create a service marketplace?

Yes, Gigneo allows you to create a service marketplace for businesses and customers to connect. It’s ideal for local services, home services, professional services, and more.

Can I use Gigneo to create a job marketplace?

Yes, Gigneo includes powerful features for creating a job marketplace where employers can post job listings and job seekers can apply. It’s great for remote work, part-time gigs, and full-time employment platforms.

Does Gigneo support wallet payments?

Yes, Gigneo includes a built-in wallet and credit system for secure payments, withdrawals, and commissions. Freelancers can receive payments directly to their wallets, and clients can fund their accounts for easy transactions.

Is Gigneo built on WooCommerce?

Yes, Gigneo is built on top of WooCommerce, giving you access to a powerful e-commerce system for handling payments, commissions, and transactions. You can leverage the flexibility of WooCommerce while building your marketplace.

Is Gigneo developer friendly?

Yes, Gigneo is built with developers in mind. With a modular architecture, extensive hooks and filters, and comprehensive documentation, you can easily customize and extend the plugin to fit your specific marketplace needs.

Where can I find documentation for Gigneo?

You can find comprehensive documentation and tutorials for Gigneo in our Knowledge Base.
